items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Bill Beaudry made her arrangements for her act.

ctx.x: Yeah. Anybody that's a good ear, they make out better that way than they do.

Just like when with Celie now. She had a colored boy around New York by the name of Bill Beaudry. Bill Beaudry made all her arrangements. He made arrangements for the Ziegfeld, see? And the Dillingham shows. Bill Beaudry made her arrangements for her act. Other than the popular songs that were my act, I had to do what I want with them. But the big introductions and the finales and stuff like that. Yeah. And I sat right there. Of course we played, I learned mine from the piano, see? Charlie played the piano and…
